direction.summary: Make the governed Execution-to-MGSN provider delivery loop durable and authenticated through explicit eligibility, allocation, provider acceptance, Provider Return and evidence handoff without Payment, legal appointment or Official Truth authority.

decisionAlternatives.reason: Directly continues durable Order/Matter truth and closes the MVP provider-return delivery loop while preserving the no-Official-Truth boundary.
Finance does not close the delivery loop and Payment is explicitly not performance, authority, acceptance or completion.
Trademark-office submission requires a later protected external-action and Official Truth boundary after durable execution/provider evidence exists.
Customer lifecycle projections should consume durable provider/execution truth rather than expand around fixture operational state.

semanticBoundaries.providerSupplyCapability: private operational supply-side capability evidence; not user Capability evidence
semanticBoundaries.allocation: internal governed MGSN assignment decision; not provider acceptance or legal appointment
semanticBoundaries.providerAcceptance: provider acceptance of the internal Service Package; not office acceptance
semanticBoundaries.providerReturn: structured provider claim/evidence package; not Official Truth
semanticBoundaries.evidenceHandoff: reviewable internal evidence transfer to Execution; not Matter completion or filing truth

primaryAcceptanceJourney: load exact current governed Execution source
create durable MGSN Service Package from exact source version/fingerprint
evaluate deterministic provider eligibility without allocation
explicitly allocate one current eligible provider
record durable Provider Return with provenance and returned evidence
hand exact Provider Return version/fingerprint to Execution for reviewable evidence
restart runtimes and reload exact source/package/allocation/return/evidence identities
prove Payment, legal appointment, external filing and Official Truth consequences remain false
requiredSourceEvidence: Execution Release or Filing Execution Task Draft reference/version
document/instruction references or immutable bounded snapshot
Channel and Relationship Model lineage where applicable

authorityConsequences.servicePackageCreated: may become true only after explicit governed MGSN source admission
authorityConsequences.providerAllocated: may become true only after explicit authorized Allocation command
authorityConsequences.providerAccepted: may become true only after authenticated provider acceptance
authorityConsequences.providerReturnCreated: may become true only after explicit provider return command
authorityConsequences.executionEvidenceHandedOff: may become true only after exact idempotent Evidence Handoff

persistence.handoffRequirement: exact-version/fingerprint APIs with safe retry and replay
